newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Endemol to cooperate with Dodger.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Endemol to cooperate with Dodger.

text.p: Dutch television production and entertainment group Endemol Entertainment NV said on Tuesday it had agreed to set up a 50-50 joint venture with U.S. theatre producer Dodger Productions.
The jointly owned company, called Dodger Endemol Theatrical Productions Inc, will produce theatre shows outside of the Netherlands, Endemol said in a statement.
Endemol said the new joint venture would have an important position in the ranks of international theatre producers.

"The new company gives Endemol a strong partner in the U.S. and access to the rights on producing a large number of theatre shows," it said. The cooperation would enable Dodger to gain a foothold on the European continent, it added.
Dodgers and Endemol have already jointly produced theatre shows in the past and are currently cooperating in producing the London musical of The Who's Tommy.
Dodger is active as a producer on Broadway and London's West End and with travelling shows in the U.S. and Britain.
